_about: Re-evaluation schedule for the experiment registry (docs/experiments/). Read by scripts/experiments/scoreboard.js. 'by' = what produces the numbers: grader (scripts/experiments/grade.js on the daily export), records (hand count on the export), replay (a tick replay; command or location in 'how'), report (descriptive only). 'need' = the sample arm of the registered pass rule (optional 'need.count' = a record counter, lib.js countRecords: { population: bot | bot_and_operator (lib.js inPopulation), exit_family: a family or a list (stored exit_family, else derived from close_reason), since: ISO, compared with recorded_at } — the row's n is then counted from the perf records, 0 when nothing matches yet);'time_arm' = the date the rule forces a verdict; 'report_by' = no forced verdict, the count is reported to the operator on that date. 'recheck_days' = how often the numbers must be refreshed at the latest. 'on_met_kind' = what a met verdict leads to (auto_promote | proposal | operator_decision | none); 'operator_question' = what the operator is asked to decide now (null = nothing; non-null puts the experiment in 'waiting on the operator' on the dashboard's Experiments board, written by scripts/experiments/publish.js).
